newsitem.title: USA: Ticketmaster says IPO prices at $14.50.
newsitem.headline: Ticketmaster says IPO prices at $14.50.

text.p: Ticketmaster Group Inc said on Monday its initial public offering of 7.25 million shares was priced at $14.50 per share.
The estimated pricing range on the offering was $13 to $15 per share.
All of the shares are being offered by Ticketmaster, the company said. No shares are being offered by existing shareholders.
The company said the proceeds from the IPO will be used to repay debt incurred to acquire various licenses, joint venture partners and minority interests, and for general corporate purposes.
The underwriters on the deal are Allen & Co Inc, Lazard Freres & Co LLC, and Smith Barney Inc.
